en_title: GTA 6's Jason and Lucia Will Start as Small-Time Criminals Who Have to Work Up to High-Value Jobs
cn_title: 《GTA6》中的Jason和Lucia将从小打小闹的罪犯做起，逐步接下高价值的活
opus_summary: 《卫报》报道称，《GTA6》主角Jason和Lucia初期只能偷开低档车辆、撬开普通锁具，之后才能逐步接手高价值任务。抢劫前进行额外准备可能让行动更顺利。Rockstar还表示，游戏将首次加入鼓励同理心的机制。《GTA6》将于11月19日登陆PS5和XBOX Series。

paragraphs.en: GTA 6 will let Jason and Lucia pull off high-value jobs, but Rockstar Games asks players to work up from being small-time criminals first.
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA6》将让Jason和Lucia完成高价值的活，但Rockstar要求玩家先从小打小闹的罪犯做起，逐步向上发展。

paragraphs.en: The latest peek at this week's new Grand Theft Auto game arrived courtesy of a preview piece from The Guardian (via @GameRoll_ ). It included interviews with Rockstar North co-studio head Rob Nelson and head of publishing Jennifer Kolbe, who covered the kind of people GTA 6 will cater to and the kind of people it's about.
paragraphs.cn: 本周，我们得以通过卫报的一篇前瞻文章（经由@GameRoll_）一窥《侠盗猎车手》系列新作的最新情况。文章采访了Rockstar North工作室联合负责人Rob Nelson和发行主管Jennifer Kolbe，两人谈到了《GTA6》面向的是怎样的玩家，以及游戏讲述的是怎样的人。

paragraphs.en: Jason and Lucia are two names we've heard for years, and they're not about to go away any time soon. After 13 years, faithful GTA fans will soon finally go hands-on with the next mainline game in the groundbreaking open-world sandbox series. They won't be able to immediately pull off front-page heists out of the gate, though.
paragraphs.cn: Jason和Lucia这两个名字我们已经听了多年，而且短期内还会继续听到。时隔13年，《侠盗猎车手》的忠实粉丝很快终于能亲手体验这一开创性开放世界沙盒系列的下一部正传作品。不过，他们没法一上来就完成足以上头条的抢劫案。

paragraphs.en: The Guardian said players won't be allowed to have the duo rob Vice City jewelry stores or drive around Leonida in sports cars in the early moments of GTA 6. Instead, they'll only be able to "hotwire low-end vehicles and pick basic locks" until they work their way up to high-value work later. What the threshold to reach those moments is remains unclear, but considering Rockstar has toiled away on the game for more than a decade, it's probably best that players don't burn their way to the top too quickly.
paragraphs.cn: 卫报称，在《GTA6》初期，玩家不能让二人抢劫Vice City的珠宝店，也不能开着跑车在Leonida四处兜风。相反，他们只能「通过接线启动低档车辆，撬开普通锁具」，直到之后逐步接下高价值的活。目前还不清楚达到那些阶段需要满足什么条件，但考虑到Rockstar已经为这款游戏辛勤工作了十多年，玩家或许最好不要太快一路冲到顶端。

paragraphs.en: Nelson described the "younger couple" as a pair with "their backs against the wall" when we first meet them. We've known that GTA 6 takes after Red Dead Redemption 2 in some respects, so Jason and Lucia won't be whipping out RPGs from their back pocket – at least at first. The piece added that robbing everything from gas stations to upscale mall boutiques might be easier or more fruitful if players take the time to complete extra steps. That might mean disabling security cameras or stealing surveillance footage, or it could mean scoping out locations for more discreet entry points.
paragraphs.cn: Nelson形容这对「年轻情侣」在我们初次见到他们时已「走投无路」。我们已经知道，《GTA6》在某些方面借鉴了《荒野大镖客：救赎2》，因此Jason和Lucia不会从后裤兜里掏出火箭筒——至少一开始不会。文章补充说，如果玩家花时间完成额外步骤，从抢劫加油站到洗劫高档商场精品店等各种行动可能会更容易，或是收获更丰。这可能意味着关闭监控摄像头或偷走监控录像，也可能意味着勘察地点，寻找更隐蔽的入口。

paragraphs.en: Skip the prep and a robbery might get chaotic quickly. That's where thinking on your toes will prove beneficial not only for your success but for Jason and Lucia, too. Judging by some of the Wanted System changes Rockstar has detailed in the past, players might want to think twice before making any knee-jerk reactions.
paragraphs.cn: 如果跳过准备工作，抢劫可能很快就会陷入混乱。这时，随机应变不仅有助于玩家成功，对Jason和Lucia也有好处。根据Rockstar过去详细介绍过的一些通缉系统改动来看，玩家在做出任何下意识反应之前或许应该三思。

paragraphs.en: A more detailed and realistic world line with another new element Rockstar accounted for: empathy . As detailed by The Guardian, Nelson and the rest of the team have promised that GTA 6 includes "mechanisms for encouraging" empathy for the first time in series history. What exactly that means remains to be seen, but with many details and different ways to play, we probably won't fully understand the developers' vision until we meet Jason and Lucia ourselves.
paragraphs.cn: 一个更细致、更真实的世界与Rockstar考虑到的另一个新元素相符：同理心。正如卫报详细报道的那样，Nelson和团队其他成员承诺，《GTA6》将首次在系列中加入「鼓励」同理心的「机制」。这究竟意味着什么还有待观察，但考虑到游戏有许多细节和不同的玩法，我们或许要等到亲自见到Jason和Lucia后，才能完全理解开发者的构想。

paragraphs.en: GTA 6 launches for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S November 19. For more, you can check out IGN's preview from earlier this year. You can also check out the recent leak that spilled the full track list for the game's official album , and why we're excited to jump into Vice City, even if it's at 30 fps .
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA6》将于11月19日登陆PS5和XBOX Series。想了解更多信息，可以查看IGN今年早些时候的前瞻。你还可以看看最近泄露的游戏官方专辑完整曲目列表，以及为什么即使帧率只有30 fps，我们仍然很期待投身Vice City。
